_comment: Maps each research.html <!-- AUTO-GENERATED:<KEY>:... --> block to an ordered list of papers from the SciX library. Use the ADS bibcode for published papers (e.g. 2025ApJ...989..103M) or the bare arXiv id for preprints (e.g. 2606.04093). update_publications.py resolves these against the library and rewrites the matching block in research.html. New library papers aren't auto-added to a section here -- add them manually to keep the topic grouping meaningful, or they'll just show up in publications.html.
